entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality and training purposes. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I think I need to make a return? I'm not sure how this works. I'm a bit overwhelmed.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Isaac. I can certainly help you figure this out. May I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... um, let me see... VF88124. I'm just so confused by the website.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Trail Helmet purchased last month. To start, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, nothing is broken. It's just... the color isn't what I expected at all. I was worried about the safety features too, if it was the right one for me. The box is still unopened. I tried to read the policy online and it was all so much. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria, I can absolutely help. There's no need to feel overwhelmed. Let me just take a look at the return eligibility for your order. One moment.
Okay, I see the delivery was 36 days ago. According to our policy for standard items like this helmet, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process this for a full refund.
Oh, really? It's that simple? That's such a relief! Thank you so much.

You are very welcome, Maria. I'm happy to make this easy for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. And since I see you're a VIP member with us, I've also gone ahead and added a $10 credit to your account for any inconvenience. You can use that on your next purchase.
Wow, thank you! I wasn't expecting that. You've been incredibly helpful, Isaac.
It's my pleasure. Just print that label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
